work.name: NeoDocs (YC S21)
responsibilities: Developed a fault-tolerant, high-throughput MongoDB server from scratch, reducing query latency by 10x, and integrated this into legacy systems to save an estimated $10K annually.
Created a WebAssembly SDK integrating OpenCV.js that standardized image capture to 95% consistency across diverse devices and lighting conditions, expediting application prototyping by 20%.

Developed an end-to-end data solution by building a scalable pipeline and an interactive dashboard. Pre-aggregated 1M+ data points from diverse sources to reduce load times by 60%, and directly contributed to the success of a $50K government project.
Spearheaded a team of 3 to develop a cross-platform mobile app that reached 100K+ downloads and 35K+ monthly active users, achieving an average rating of 4.3 stars.
additionalResponsibilities: Introduced in-app tracking and multilingual, server-controlled ads that launched an app's first revenue channel through targeted cross-selling.

Designed and developed a camera plugin by integrating native and C++ (OpenCV) code, ensuring a consistent image capture experience, eliminating over 90% of camera errors, and saving an estimated 20 development hours per app.
Implemented edge ML in a Flutter app using a fine-tuned YOLO TFLite model with real-time visual overlays and haptic feedback, improving image capture accuracy by 80% using boundary detection.
Engineered a camera plugin that optimized exposure controls using computer vision, increasing successful captures by 30% and boosting Random Forest ensemble model efficiency.

work.name: NeoDocs (YC S21)
